title: How well do various QM-derived net atomic charges reproduce the electrostatic potential surrounding a material across multiple geometric conformations?
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23223-23265
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07900K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alma Carolina Escobosa, Thomas A. Manz
This article compares the accuracy of various atomic charge schemes for reproducing the electrostatic potential surrounding organic, inorganic, and heterodiatomic molecules, transition metal complexes, and nanoporous solids.
